items.title: RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. The RIAA presents both as "additional" areas of concern, not as offic…

items.title: Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Deezer permitirá ocultar la música hecha con IA al buscar
items.summary: Deezer permitirá a sus usuarios ocultar la música generada íntegramente con inteligencia artificial. La plataforma francesa ha anunciado un interruptor que, una vez activado, excluirá de los resultados de búsqueda las canciones, los álbumes y los artistas vinculados a contenido 100% sintético. La función llegará a todo…

items.title: YouTube Music etiqueta la música generada con IA
items.summary: YouTube Music ha empezado a etiquetar las canciones creadas «principalmente con inteligencia artificial generativa». La etiqueta aparece en la pantalla del reproductor y, al pulsarla, se abre un menú con más información. La función se amplía también a la aplicación principal de YouTube, según anunció la plataforma el 1…

items.title: UK Copyright Tribunal ruling recognises “increased value of music in cinema” says PRS
items.summary: A dispute over what royalties cinemas should pay PRS for music contained in the films they screen went before the UK Copyright Tribunal earlier this year. It has ruled in favour of a higher royalty rate which, PRS says, “recognises the increased value of music in the overall cinema experience”

items.title: La industria musical australiana advierte al Parlamento contra la flexibilización de las leyes de derechos de autor para permitir el uso de la inteligencia artificial.
Sara Landry’s legal battle with ex-managers over commissions, copyrights and trademarks now being fought out in US and UK
items.summary: In August, London-based management firm The Night Department sued techno producer Sara Landry for breach of contract. She has now responded and countersued. The core dispute is over the management company’s involvement in her label, though there’s also some griping over a Coachella pissing incident

items.title: Major publishers tell US Supreme Court they must intervene in termination rights ruling that “threatens the licensing of copyrighted works throughout the world”
items.summary: The major music publishers and BMG have submitted a new filing with the US Supreme Court in the ongoing termination rights legal battle involving songwriter Cyril Vetter. He recently told the Supreme Court to ignore the publishers’ doomsaying about this case - their new filing has plenty of that

items.title: Suno-made track ‘The Adult I Dreamed Of’ is a hit in South Korea
items.summary: Last month we wrote about a debate breaking out in South Korea after an AI-generated song called ‘Forest of the Heart’ appeared in the lower reaches of streaming service Melon’s Top 100 chart. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: YouTube Music to label AI-generated tracks using its own system
items.summary: YouTube Music is the latest of the big streaming services to reveal how it plans to label AI-generated music. Its labels went live yesterday (14 October) for songs “created primarily using generative AI”. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Lee los términos del generador de IA que usas
tip.body: Cada plataforma decide por contrato qué puedes hacer comercialmente con lo que generas y qué derechos se reserva. Dos herramientas parecidas pueden darte licencias completamente distintas.

tip.title: Read the terms of the AI generator you use
tip.body: Each platform decides by contract what you may do commercially with your outputs and what rights it keeps. Two similar tools can grant completely different licenses.
